mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_NO, MEMBER_ID, MEMBER_PWD, MEMBER_NAME, PHONE, EMAIL, MEMBER_IMG, ROLE, CREATE_DATE, DEL_YN, MEMBER_IMG_PATH FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET DEL_YN = 'Y' WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.select:
SELECT
MATERIAL_NAME FROM
MEMBER_ALLERGY WHERE
MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY
MEMBER_ALLERGY_NO
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER ( MEMBER_ID, MEMBER_PWD, MEMBER_NAME, PHONE, EMAIL ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{memberPwd}, #{memberName}, #{phone}, #{email} )
mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_NO, MEMBER_ID, MEMBER_PWD, MEMBER_NAME, PHONE, EMAIL, MEMBER_IMG, ROLE, CREATE_DATE, DEL_YN, MEMBER_IMG_PATH FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM MEMBER WHERE EMAIL = #{email} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM MEMBER WHERE PHONE = #{phone} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
